reuse.why: Changes the single existing getScheduledAmount helper and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the approximate tolerance instead of re-deriving 7.5%.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; the API field calls the same helper the rest of the app uses.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts; the API only decorates its list result in server/api.ts.

scope.why: Focused on the rule and its callers, with a stray import reorder in schedules/app.ts; the API docs and release note still describe the superseded 'furthest from zero' rule.

maintainability.why: One definition owns the planned amount, but every caller must now remember to pass the operator, and the docs/release note text is stale relative to step 4.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All planning call sites (preview, posting, forecast, templates, UI, API) go through getScheduledAmount.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains an op parameter (and loses the rangeRounding option); the isapprox branch is the rule itself, not a caller special case; useScheduleEdit's two op-less calls are form conversions, not planning.
